encounters.title: The Warm Mirage
encounters.description: A street musician plays a melody that sounds exactly like a memory you never lived. The crowd smiles in unison.

choices.label: Smile and applaud the melody (Empathy DC 10)
choices.success_text: The Prism rewards your gentleness with a clear Echo Shard, though Mira watches you with a quiet, testing gaze.
choices.failure_text: Your applause rings slightly hollow; the crowd's smiles flicker for a heartbeat.

choices.label: Listen for the dissonance beneath the chords (Perception DC 12)
choices.success_text: Beneath the major key, a low gravitational hum vibrates in the cobblestones. You glimpse the Veil's true depth.
choices.failure_text: The warmth overwhelms your focus, leaving only a faint ache behind your eyes.

encounters.title: The Unblinking Cloister
encounters.description: Three prayer mirrors line the white archway. As the Stilling Bell tolls, one mirror shows an iron confessional instead of your face.

choices.label: Hold the mirror's gaze without flinching (Resolve DC 13)
choices.success_text: Hairline cracks bloom across the silver glass, revealing a hidden latch to the Covenant confessional.
choices.failure_text: You look away as the bell rings sharp; the reflection snaps back to serene white stone.

choices.label: Hum in resonance with the Stilling Bell (Veil Attunement DC 12)
choices.success_text: The bell answers with a warm overtone, granting you clarity without shattering the sanctuary.
choices.failure_text: The harmonic slips, shaking loose a brief storm ripple.

encounters.title: The Easy Shortcut
encounters.description: A smiling wayfarer slides an unblemished prism charm across the table, swearing it lets you bypass every Veil storm without ever feeling doubt.

choices.label: Decline the charm — shallow comfort breeds false endings (Clarity DC 11)
choices.success_text: Kaelen nods approvingly from behind the bar and slides you a genuine Echo Shard.
choices.failure_text: The wayfarer laughs lightly, leaving you wondering if ease really was so dangerous.

choices.label: Ask what they lost to learn about that charm (Empathy DC 10)
choices.success_text: Their smile fades into honesty; they whisper a forgotten bearing toward The Stillward.
choices.failure_text: They change the subject and raise their glass to Caetherra's endless warmth.

encounters.title: The Unspoken Reflection
encounters.description: The water inside the Mirror Well ripples against the wind, revealing a moment you almost chose to forget.

choices.label: Keep watching until the ripple settles (Perception DC 12)
choices.success_text: Ashara's reflection appears beside yours for a heartbeat, sharpening your resonance.
choices.failure_text: The surface clouds over with soft grey mist.

encounters.title: Walking Through Memory Ash
encounters.description: A furnace vents a slow curtain of silver-grey ash across the catwalk. Every flake carries a sting of someone else's abandoned certainty.

choices.label: Walk straight through without shielding your eyes (Resolve DC 13)
choices.success_text: Vael watches from the gantry and gives a rare, sharp nod. You held the memory without flinching.
choices.failure_text: You cough and step back, though a single ember of insight lingers.

choices.label: Let the Veil attune the drifting fragments (Veil Attunement DC 12)
choices.success_text: The ash parts around your lantern light, revealing a chalk sigil pointing down to the Ember Vaults.
choices.failure_text: The fragments scatter into static before you can read them.

encounters.title: The Taut Thread of Vault Seven
encounters.description: Beside the Memory Anvil, a single silver thread vibrates like a harp string leading straight into sealed Vault Seven.

choices.label: Touch the thread to hear whose belief sleeps inside (Veil Attunement DC 14)
choices.success_text: A resonant chime rings through the vault; The Rendered steps closer and speaks of the Nine Sisters.
choices.failure_text: The thread snaps taut with a cold jolt, sealing the vault door tighter.

encounters.title: The Weight of Being Known
encounters.description: The Dark Quasar's gravity surges across Obsidian Reach. Every unspoken doubt you carry rises like iron filings toward the sky.

choices.label: Name your doubt aloud and stand firm (Clarity DC 15)
choices.success_text: The gravity does not crush you—it anchors you. The Quasar recognizes earned trust.
choices.failure_text: Suspicion spikes through your bonds as the membrane strains, yet you survive with a sharper eye.
